slots.purpose: Hero: sets the luxury, editorial tone and shows what a place card looks like in situ.
slots.shot_brief: Close, eye-level shot of one place card resting on a folded linen napkin on a fully set long table: fine china, crystal stemware, candlelight or soft late-afternoon daylight, muted neutral palette with one seasonal green. Calligraphy name is a placeholder (e.g. 'Guest Name') or out of focus. No people, no visible stationer logo or branding, no identifiable venue. Landscape 3:2, room for title overlay on one side.
slots.notes: AI fallback possible only as a generic still life with Nic's approval, captioned 'Illustrative image'. Licensed photography strongly preferred for the hero.

slots.purpose: Show a natural or edible place card idea (leaf, fruit).
slots.shot_brief: Overhead or 45-degree flat-lay of a natural place card on a plate: a magnolia or olive leaf with a hand-lettered placeholder name in gold or white ink, or a fig, pear or citrus with a small tag. Linen napkin, simple cutlery, daylight. No people, no branding. Square or 4:5.
slots.notes: AI option: a generic still life (no real venue, destination or wedding) may be generated in Higgsfield ONLY if Nic approves; then caption exactly 'Illustrative image', placeholder names only, source.type ai_illustrative.

slots.purpose: Show a place card guests take home (favour doubling as a name card).
slots.shot_brief: Close detail of a keepsake place card: e.g. a small engraved wooden or ceramic tag, mini candle or tiny jar with a name tag, set on a dinner plate. Soft daylight, neutral palette. Placeholder name only. No people, no maker's mark or stationer branding. 4:5.
slots.notes: AI option: a generic still life (no real venue, destination or wedding) may be generated in Higgsfield ONLY if Nic approves; then caption exactly 'Illustrative image', placeholder names only, source.type ai_illustrative.

slots.purpose: Show a clear glass or acrylic place card, a modern luxury option.
slots.shot_brief: Clear acrylic or glass tile place card with white or gold lettering (placeholder name) standing at a place setting; backlit by candlelight or window light so the lettering reads. Crystal glassware, minimal florals. No people, no branding, no recognisable venue. Landscape 3:2.
slots.notes: AI option: a generic still life (no real venue, destination or wedding) may be generated in Higgsfield ONLY if Nic approves; then caption exactly 'Illustrative image', placeholder names only, source.type ai_illustrative.

slots.purpose: Tie the ideas to the destination-wedding audience: place cards with local touches.
slots.shot_brief: Real destination reception table with local touches in the place cards: e.g. lemon and olive sprig cards on an Amalfi Coast or Puglia terrace, or frangipani on a Bali villa table, golden-hour light, sea or landscape softly behind. Must be a real, documented wedding or venue shoot: source from the Wedded Image Library or a partner venue's supplied images with blog-use licence and couple consent; location proven by register, EXIF or photographer gallery. Never AI. No identifiable guests without consent. Landscape 3:2.
